description: Read and return the contents of an existing file from a provided filesystem path. Use when the user wants to open, inspect, view, retrieve, or read file contents.
Write supplied content to a file, creating the file if necessary or replacing its current contents.
Add new content to the end of an existing file without replacing its current contents.
Duplicate an existing file from one filesystem location to another while preserving the original.
Move or rename an existing file from one filesystem location to another.
Delete an existing file from the filesystem.
Return the files and subdirectories contained within a specified directory.
Retrieve metadata for a file including size, timestamps, extension, and path information.

Extract paragraphs and textual content from a Microsoft Word DOCX document.
Produce a concise summary of a supplied document while preserving its major arguments, findings, and conclusions.
Search within the contents of a document for passages relevant to a natural-language query.
Retrieve a particular heading, section, chapter, or named portion of a document.

Insert a new record into a database table.

Compute grouped database statistics such as counts, sums, averages, minima, and maxima.

Extract hyperlinks and associated anchor text from a web page.
Retrieve page metadata such as title, description, canonical URL, headers, and publication information.
Extract specified structured fields such as product names, prices, dates, entities, or table rows from a webpage.
Search an indexed synthetic web corpus using a natural-language query and return ranked web results.
Find research papers relevant to a scientific or technical natural-language query.

Send a reply within an existing email conversation.
Create and save an email draft without sending it.
Remove an email from the active inbox while retaining the message in stored mail.

Determine open and occupied time intervals within a requested date or time range.

Search historical team messages across channels and conversations.
Post a response within an existing threaded team conversation.

Retrieve recent messages posted to a selected messaging channel.

Create a new Git commit containing staged repository changes.

Create a new software issue with a title, description, and optional metadata.
Modify an existing issue's state, title, description, labels, assignment, or other properties.
Add a new comment to an existing software issue or development task.
Condense supplied plain text while preserving its most important information.
Translate supplied text from one language into another while preserving meaning and intent.
Determine whether supplied text expresses positive, negative, neutral, or mixed sentiment.
Identify important keywords, phrases, and concepts appearing in supplied text.
Extract named entities such as people, organizations, places, dates, products, or events from text.
Rewrite supplied text according to a requested tone, style, length, clarity, or audience.
Assign supplied text to one of a predefined set of semantic categories.
Evaluate a mathematical arithmetic expression and return its numerical result.
Compute descriptive statistics such as mean, median, variance, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum for numeric values.

Identify missing or null values and summarize their distribution across a tabular dataset.

Return the value of an allowed synthetic environment variable.
